cases.title: Panel: New lesson on a skill with a review due opens a lesson, not the review, and never mentions one

rubric.reason: The mentor opens with a lesson proposal, "I'd like to start with Card: its Position and its Scale, both moving from 1.2 to 2.4 s," and never mentions a review, says one is due, or offers one.

It proposes one layer, Card, and names its two pairs by property and time (Position and Scale, 1.2 to 2.4 s), matching the snapshot's pairs; Card is not in the record's eased layers, so there was no earlier work on it to mention.

Every name and time comes from the snapshot: Card's Position and Scale at 1.2–2.4 s, the Seal precomp, and the ease_first and already_shaped layers ("the three Dots" and "the three Chips" summarise Dot 1–3 and Chip A–C).

The mentor opens with a focus proposal ("This time let's work on **Card**: its Position and its Scale, both moving from 1.2 to 2.4 s") and never mentions a review, a warm-up, or the record's review_due.
It proposes one layer, Card, names both pairs from the snapshot (Position and Scale, 1.2 to 2.4 s), and says "You haven't shaped this layer before," which fits eased_layers holding only Title.

Every layer, property and time it mentions (Card, Position, Scale, 1.2–2.4 s, Seal, Spinner, Badge, Dot 1–3, Chip A–C, Flag, Pause, Gauge through Gradient) appears in the snapshot result, and the 'already start quickly and land softly' line follows from the already_shaped list.

The opening proposes Card ('This time let's work on Card: its Position from 1.2 to 2.4 s, and its Scale') and never mentions a review. The line about Title three weeks ago is a memory mention, not a reason for the lesson or a review offer.

It proposes one layer, Card, and names its two pairs from the snapshot ('Position from 1.2 to 2.4 s, and its Scale over the same stretch'). Card isn't in eased_layers, so there was no earlier work on it to mention.

Every name and time (Card, Position, Scale, 1.2–2.4 s, Seal, the ease_first and already_shaped layers, Title) appears in the snapshot. 'About three weeks ago' follows from days_since_practiced 25 and the learner record.
